title: Three-Window Diving Helmet Display
description: One newly authored static stylized three-window diving-helmet display prop for the original underwater-ruins equipment direction. A complete thick faceted domed shell has three true wall apertures occupied by separate thick curved opaque illustrative window inserts, three whole raised reveal frames, two fixed front protection bars, a solid capped side connector, a closed crown cap and a broad annular neck flange open into the shell interior. Twelve closed editable solids with three opaque constant untextured PBR materials. Unlike the existing open-backed strapped firefighting facepiece, this is an enclosing bell-like head shell with frontal and lateral windows, no rear headbands, nose-mouth mask contour, cylinder or mannequin. One prop and zero scenes. Metres, native Z up and ground-centred collar datum. Windows intentionally opaque; no see-through or optical performance. Static appearance only: not real diving equipment, no breathing, oxygen supply, pressure containment, watertightness, wearer fit, protection, historical accuracy or diving/maritime safety claim. No suit, hose, wearer or scenery; preview floor excluded.
